title: Efficiency: outbuf deferred allocation wastes 4096 bytes per session
description: crypto2dev_fd.c — outbuf starts NULL at open() and is allocated lazily on first write() via outbuf_grow(). CRYPTO2DEV_OUTBUF_INIT=4096 bytes are only allocated when update() is first called. Sessions that call only KEY_IMPORT, KEY_GENERATE, DO_SIGN, DO_VERIFY, or DO_AGREE never touch outbuf at all; they pay zero bytes. This is correct and efficient. Not a real issue — confirm this is intentional so it is not flagged by a reviewer as 'uninitialized'.
